description: Angular component for edge instructions dialog in the Thingsboard UI, handling display and retrieval of installation or upgrade instructions for edge devices.

classes.name: EdgeInstructionsDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying edge installation or upgrade instructions, managing user interactions and data fetching.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and fetches instructions based on the current tab.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, optionally saving user preferences if 'do not show again' is checked.

methods.name: selectedTabChange
methods.description: Handles tab change events and fetches corresponding instructions.

methods.name: getInstructions
methods.description: Fetches instructions for the specified method, either upgrade or install, and updates the component state.
